modelingNotes: Flatiron Building — original procedural geometry, CC0-1.0. bun generators/flatiron-building.ts

Map frame: x east, y north, z up, metres, rotated so +y runs along the wedge's long axis (BEARING). Anchor is the OSM outline's centroid. The footprint is the OSM outline (way/264768896) itself, rotated into that frame; the low rooftop attic follows its building:part (way/764237515, 88 m). No textures: window bands, piers, belts and the cornice are geometry.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "flatiron-building", model "flatiron-building"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/flatiron-building.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
